title: Conormal fibres commute with an extension of the ground field
statement:
Let $k\to K$ be an extension of fields, let $C$ be a finite type commutative $k$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra], and choose a presentation $P=k[x_1,\ldots,x_n]\twoheadrightarrow C$ with kernel $I$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. Put $P_K=K[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$, let $I_K\subseteq P_K$ be the ideal generated by the coefficientwise images of $I$, and identify $C_K=K\otimes_k C$ with $P_K/I_K$ [lem-weil-pbc-presentation-base-change]. Let $\mathfrak q_K\subset C_K$ be prime, let $\mathfrak q$ be its inverse image in $C$, and let $\mathfrak q'$ and $\mathfrak q_K'$ be their inverse images in $P$ and $P_K$. Then the coefficient-extension map induces a canonical isomorphism of $\kappa(\mathfrak q_K)$-vector spaces
$$
 (I/I^2)_{\mathfrak q}\otimes_{C_{\mathfrak q}}\kappa(\mathfrak q)\otimes_{\kappa(\mathfrak q)}\kappa(\mathfrak q_K)\;\xrightarrow{\sim}\;(I_K/I_K^2)_{\mathfrak q_K}\otimes_{(C_K)_{\mathfrak q_K}}\kappa(\mathfrak q_K),
$$
where $\kappa(\mathfrak q)\to\kappa(\mathfrak q_K)$ is induced by $C\to C_K$, and the map sends $(f\bmod I^2)\otimes\lambda$ to $\lambda$ times the coefficientwise image of $f$ modulo $I_K^2$. In particular, the two vector spaces have the same finite dimension.

source.place: Tag 00SI (lemma-lci-field-change-local), proof lines 36215--36259: the displayed conormal-fibre identity and the application of Nakayama.

proof.text: Use MvPolynomial.algebraTensorAlgEquiv and the tensor factor swap to identify P_K as a P-algebra with P tensor_k K, where p maps to p tensor 1. The field extension K is a free k-module, so its base change is a free, hence flat, P-module. Transport flatness across the algebra equivalence. This uses only flatness, rather than faithful flatness or the quotient presentation.

Apply the existing proved Algebra.flat_cotangent_bijective from WeilConjectures.RingTheory.StrictHenselizationCotangentDimension, imported with import all because it is private. For the flat map gamma and J = I.map gamma it gives bijectivity of P_K tensor_P I.Cotangent to J.Cotangent. This is the general ring-map form of Mathlib flat conormal base change; no duplicate cotangent transport helpers are declared. The map sends b tensor [f] to b times [gamma(f)].

Take the residue-field homomorphism F to L supplied by Ideal.ResidueField.map for the contraction qP = qPK.comap gamma. Give L its P-algebra structure by the composite P to P_K to L. Ideal.ResidueField.map_algebraMap verifies that this also equals the composite through F. Explicitly register the associated modules to avoid the unrelated residue-field module instance.

For either prime q and any module M, LocalizedModule.equivTensorProduct and TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange identify kappa(q) tensor_(P_q) M_q with kappa(q) tensor_P M. The identification sends a tensor (m/1) to a tensor m. Extend the first such equivalence from F to L, cancel F, insert scalar extension to P_K, apply the flat conormal isomorphism tensored with L, and apply the inverse second localization equivalence. This constructs the required L-linear equivalence. Evaluate every component on the relation class f using the pure-tensor formulas; the image is exactly the localized class of gamma(f).

The Hilbert basis theorem makes the finite polynomial ring P Noetherian. Its ideal I and quotient I.Cotangent are finite modules. Scalar extension to F is finite, and the localization-cancellation equivalence therefore proves finite dimensionality of the first fibre. Scalar extension from F to L and the constructed equivalence give finite dimensionality of the second fibre. Finally combine LinearEquiv.finrank_eq with Module.finrank_baseChange. These arguments include the zero-dimensional and zero-variable cases.

lean.statement: theorem lciConormalFibreFieldChange (k : Type u) (K : Type v) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K] (C : Type w) [CommRing C] [Algebra k C] (n : ℕ) (π : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k →ₐ[k] C) (hπ : Function.Surjective π) (qK : Ideal (K ⊗[k] C)) [qK.IsPrime] : let γ : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k →+* MvPolynomial (Fin n) K := MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K) let πK := lciBaseChangePresentationMap k K C n π let qPK := qK.comap πK.toRingHom let qP := qPK.comap γ let I := RingHom.ker π.toRingHom let IK := I.map γ let σ := Ideal.ResidueField.map qP qPK γ (by rfl) ∃ e : lciScalarExtension qP.ResidueField qPK.ResidueField σ (lciConormalFibre qP I) ≃ₗ[qPK.ResidueField] lciConormalFibre qPK IK, (∀ (f : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) (hf : f ∈ I), e (lciScalarExtensionTmul qP.ResidueField qPK.ResidueField σ (lciConormalFibre qP I) (1 : qPK.ResidueField) (1 ⊗ₜ[Localization qP.primeCompl] (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap qP.primeCompl I.Cotangent (I.toCotangent ⟨f, hf⟩)))) = (1 : qPK.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[Localization qPK.primeCompl] (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap qPK.primeCompl IK.Cotangent (IK.toCotangent ⟨γ f, Ideal.mem_map_of_mem γ hf⟩))) ∧ FiniteDimensional qPK.ResidueField (lciConormalFibre qPK IK) ∧ FiniteDimensional qP.ResidueField (lciConormalFibre qP I) ∧ Module.finrank qPK.ResidueField (lciConormalFibre qPK IK) = Module.finrank qP.ResidueField (lciConormalFibre qP I)
